summary: Half-sister (probable) of Grazia Di Marino; John's 3rd great-grandaunt (half).
bio: Daughter of Gaetano and Maria d'Ambrosio; married Giuseppe Petriello (son of Carmine and Maria Marra) 26 Dec 1855. Key evidence that Maria d'Ambrosio was Gaetano's earlier wife.
